verdict.rationale: Bugbot connects through the Cursor GitHub app and a GitLab integration, including GitHub Enterprise Server and GitLab Self-Hosted. It runs automatically on every PR update and leaves inline comments with explanations and suggested fixes. Community users confirm it is live in their orgs posting useful PR comments. Missing for 10: no evidence of review turnaround time (the 'within minutes' part of the story is unevidenced).
